Saved vector results are kept privately for your convenience only, are never used for any other purpose, and remain strictly confidential.

privacy.coreBody: Your uploaded images are processed locally in your browser and are never sent to our servers. If you are signed in, only the generated vector results (compressed SVG paths and metadata) are saved to your private history, so you can reopen previews, adjust parameters, and download again across your devices.
privacy.coreStrong: Your data is never used for any secondary purposes, is never used to train AI models, and remains strictly confidential and private.
privacy.coreTitle: Core Principle: Your Images Stay in Your Browser
privacy.lastRevised: Last revised: November 2026 • Effective immediately for all visitors and registered users.
privacy.liCredsBody: If you sign in via Google Sign-In or email/password authentication, your user identifier (UID), email address, and profile name are securely stored via Google Firebase Authentication.
privacy.liFingerprintBody: To prevent promo-credit abuse, a device fingerprint identifier (generated locally by FingerprintJS from browser characteristics) and its association with granted accounts are stored server-side. It is used solely for anti-fraud checks and is never used for tracking or advertising.
privacy.liHistoryA: If you choose to save vector results to your history while signed in, compressed SVG paths and metadata are stored in your private Firestore record (
privacy.liHistoryB: , grouped per source image with a
privacy.liHistoryC: subcollection) protected by security rules allowing only you to access them.
privacy.liPaymentBody: When purchasing credit packs via cryptocurrency, public on-chain identifiers (transaction hash, blockchain network, credit amount, timestamp) are recorded to automatically credit your balance upon block confirmation.
privacy.liSecurityBody: We use Firebase App Check and reCAPTCHA Enterprise tokens to protect the service from automated bot attacks and denial-of-service abuse.
privacy.s1Body: When you upload an image to Pathify, it is processed entirely in your browser. The original image is never sent to our servers; it may be cached locally in your browser so you can keep editing, and you can clear it at any time. Only the vector results saved to your history while you are signed in are stored in the cloud. We do not inspect, monetize, or repurpose your content for any other objective.
privacy.s2Body: We apply a strict no-exploitation standard. Your visual assets and designs are never used to train machine learning models, are never commercialized or licensed to third parties, and are never shared with advertising networks. Your intellectual property remains exclusively yours.
privacy.s2Title: 2. Zero Secondary Use & No AI Training
privacy.s3Intro: We collect only the essential operational data necessary to manage account authentication, credit quotas, and transaction confirmations:
privacy.s4Body: Cryptocurrency transactions conducted on public blockchains (Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Bitcoin) are immutable and publicly visible on decentralized ledgers. Pathify does not custody your private keys or have access to your wallet funds. All transactions are signed by your own Web3 wallet provider (e.g. MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect).
privacy.s5Body: Pathify protects credit transactions and generation quotas with a server-side Cryptographic Handshake system. Generation tickets are signed using HMAC-SHA256 algorithms and attested against Google App Check JWKS keys. This safeguards the integrity of credits and prevents unauthorized manipulation.
privacy.s6Body: You maintain total ownership and control over your content. You may delete individual items from your vectorization history at any time through the in-app History Drawer. If you wish to delete your entire account and associated Firestore data, you can submit a request through our Support Portal.
privacy.s7Prefix: If you have questions or requests about our privacy practices or data confidentiality, please contact our support team through the support portal at
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

terms.s2FreeBody: High-resolution vectorization preview, split-screen comparison, and exports to PNG or WebP formats are completely free and do not require user login or credit consumption.

terms.s3OnchainBody: Transactions are processed on public decentralized blockchains (BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Bitcoin). Credits are credited to your account once the transaction attains the required on-chain block confirmations.
terms.s3TrackingBody: Our Cloudflare Edge Worker monitors pending transactions automatically. You can also trigger immediate verification at any time via the "Refresh Credits" button on the Transactions page.
